question: Which of the following enzymes can be considered a good marker of drug-induced hemolytic anemia ?:
analysis: Lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) is released into the bloodstream when there is tissue damage, including hemolysis. In cases of drug-induced hemolytic anemia, LDH levels are often elevated due to the destruction of red blood cells. While G6PDH is important in assessing certain types of hemolytic anemia, LDH is a more direct marker for hemolysis itself.
